text:
mira: Heads up — enterprise trial customer reporting quickstart appears to succeed but embeddings call fails with 402. They ran the sample app and saw chat respond, then embedding endpoint returned 402 Payment Required. Strange mix for a fresh workspace.

mira: curl they ran (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":["foo"]}'
```

mira: Response body:
```json
{"error":"payment_required","reason":"org.billing_unverified","message":"Workspace billing not verified","help_url":""}
```

jc: Huh. If the chat call worked that implies API key auth succeeded, but embeddings are gated by workspace billing verification for trials (we have a separate quota pipeline). Shouldn't the sample app surface that earlier?

leo: This is because the quickstart spins up two sample routes (chat + embeddings) that call different backend services. Chat was routed to the trial sandbox cluster which allows one free chat call, embeddings go through the provisioning check. We should make the quickstart run a preflight check for workspace billing status and show an inline message.

mira: Customer complained that the SDK treats 402 like a transient 5xx and we retried 3x. They saw the sample app stall and then error.

jc: SDKs currently retry on idempotent-ish errors; 402 was not special-cased. We need to mark 402 with reason org.billing_unverified as terminal and provide the console link.

support_agent: Workaround: owner needs to complete billing verification (card + org info) in console. I sent them the exact path: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<workspace-id>/billing/verify. Also created support ticket TKT-7123 and attached logs.

leo: Proposal: add new /v1/onboarding/status endpoint that returns {"workspace_id":"...","billing_state":"verified|unverified|consent_required","first_call_allowed":true|false,"help_url":"..."}. Quickstart should call this at startup and show a clear banner with link if not ready.

mira: Agree. Also two SDK changes: 1) Treat 402 + reason org.billing_unverified as non-retriable and raise a typed BillingVerificationError with help_url if present. 2) Emit a single-line friendly log: "Workspace billing verification required: open <url> to verify" when TRACE=1.

devex-bot: FYI: internal policy doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/policies/onboarding-gating. Suggested owner: @leo for quickstart change, @jc for SDK update.

jc: I'll pick up the Node + Go SDK changes (PR node#5601, go#102). Adding unit tests to assert we don't retry and that BillingVerificationError includes help_url. ETA: 3 days.

mira: Quick note for docs team: add a short section in the "first call" guide about embedding quotas and billing verification to reduce support noise.

support_agent: Customer completed verification while we chatted; embeddings now succeed. Marking TKT-7123 as resolved. Leaving a note to proactively check onboarding status on sign-up flows.

leo: I'll mock the /onboarding/status endpoint in the sample app repo and add a tiny UI banner. PR incoming.

mira: Thanks y'all. This one felt like a DX design miss more than a bug. :slightly_smiling_face:

jc: Agreed. Changing SDK behavior + quickstart preflight should cut down 80% of these tickets.

devex-bot: Tagging: @sdk-team, @quickstart, @support.

mira: Closing thread — leaving one-pager in the runbook and linking ticket INT-4999 for follow-ups.
